❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is slant height?
The distance from the tip to the base edge along the side: l = √(r² + h²) by Pythagoras.
Why is the volume divided by 3?
A cone holds exactly one-third of the cylinder with the same base and height.
Height vs slant height?
Height is vertical (tip to base center); slant height runs along the slanted side. Use height for volume.
